summary: Explains that before a release, maintainers may impose a feature freeze, delaying new features and unrelated fixes to focus on the release candidate.
questions: What is a feature freeze in Ansible development?
Why wasn't my feature PR reviewed before a release?

answer_card.title: Feature freezes
answer_card.answer_md: During final release preparation, maintainers may impose a **feature freeze**: new features and fixes unrelated to the pending release are delayed so the release candidate can be finished as soon as possible.
